cust_acme_john: Hi — we just noticed embedding vectors from /v2/embeddings suddenly changed length after we pinned our model version yesterday. Our index failed. Anyone seen this?

support_jen: sorry about that. Can you paste the request you used and one example of the returned vector length? :pray:

cust_acme_john: here's a quick repro

curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v2/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-embed-lite","input":["hello world"]}' | jq '.data[0].embedding | length'

Response: 1536

Expected: 768 (that's what we used for months)

support_jen: thanks. Did you recently pin the model version in the console or via API? Any change in the model string?

cust_acme_john: we locked to "rwd-embed-lite@2026-03-15" (via company admin UI) because of a rollout. No config changes on our side.

olivia_ml: I can reproduce locally with that pinned variant. Looks like the backend swapped to a higher-dimensional variant accidentally when the version-locked routing matched a newer variant id. I'm pulling logs.

sre_bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout rwd-embed-lite@2026-03-15 -> rwd-embed-lite-v2 completed at 2026-03-15T04:12:03Z

tariq_khan: if the variant switched, it explains index breakage. We'll need to confirm routing metadata: X-Serving-Variant header on response should show the active variant id. Can you run the same curl but include -i to see headers?

cust_acme_john: added headers:

HTTP/1.1 200 OK
X-Serving-Variant: rwd-embed-lite-v2
X-Model-Dim: 1536

support_jen: that's useful. olivia, any quick mitigation? Can we force fallback to legacy variant while we investigate?

olivia_ml: yes — temporary mitigation: set query param variant=legacy or model="rwd-embed-lite@v1" in the request. We've reenabled an explicit pinned fallback route. Example:

curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v2/embeddings?variant=legacy \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-embed-lite@v1","input":["hello world"]}' | jq '.data[0].embedding | length'

Response: 768

tariq_khan: ops note: the rollout pipeline marked rwd-embed-lite-v2 as compatible, but variant dimension wasn't verified against customers who pin by date. I'm opening an internal ticket to add a routing compatibility check (model_dim match) before completing a version freeze rollout.

support_jen: communicated workaround to customer and requested they confirm their index re-ingestion plan. @cust_acme_john do you want us to reingest on your behalf or hold while you switch?

cust_acme_john: we'll reingest; please keep the legacy fallback for 48h while we catch up. Also would like an incident postmortem when available.

olivia_ml: noted. I'll keep the fallback and coordinate with infra to add an explicit dimension assert in routing. We'll follow up with a short postmortem and timeline.

sre_bot: incident-ref INC-2026-0423 created by olivia_ml

support_jen: thanks everyone. I'll update the customer thread with the workaround steps and the incident ref. :thumbsup:

cust_acme_john: thanks all — appreciate the quick help.
